instruction: A candid outdoor medium close-up photograph of three children hugging in a sunny park filled with green trees. On the left, the curly-haired girl in a white cardigan over a rust-colored dress (R3) smiles at the camera. In the center, the boy in a blue denim shirt (R5) smiles, looking slightly to the side. On the right, the girl with bangs in a dark blue cardigan (R4) hugs the boy tightly and smiles. The scene is warmly backlit by bright sunlight, creating a soft, natural atmosphere with a shallow depth of field.
